punchline: One letter grade turned AIG's debts into demands.
thirty_sec: On 15 September 2008 all three major agencies cut AIG below AA-, and its swap contracts required more collateral. The next day the Fed authorized up to $85 billion at LIBOR plus 850 basis points, secured on AIG's assets, for 79.9 percent of its equity.
question: Which agreement you signed contains a condition that only starts when your situation gets worse?
key_contrast: The clause that sits unread on a good day and decides a bad one.
